segments.text: NW Analyst made the one-page PDF. It has a bar chart of open purchase order value by cost centre and a two-sentence summary.

**Summary in the PDF:** There are 186 open POs worth 2,172,240.01 in total. R&D (433,985.59 across 46 POs) and Operations (423,555.15 across 33 POs) together make up 39.5% of that. Marketing is lowest at 266,077.50 across 22 POs.

| Cost centre | Open POs | Open value |
|---|---|---|
| R&D | 46 | 433,985.59 |
| Operations | 33 | 423,555.15 |
| Logistics | 29 | 363,994.44 |
| Facilities | 32 | 359,681.15 |
| IT | 24 | 324,946.18 |
| Marketing | 22 | 266,077.50 |

- **Open definition:** "Open" means the purchase order status is `open` in the ERP.
- **Currency:** The ERP gives no currency, so the figures have no currency symbol.
- **Extras on the page:** Besides the chart and summary, the PDF has a title line and a short source footnote.
- **Page count:** NW Analyst checked that the PDF has 1 page.
